method: Dark-theme adaptation of the direct PDF-to-SVG export. Transparent background uses the page --paper color (#0d0e10). Original geometry, outlined text, embedded image bytes, masks and clips are retained. Recolor vector labels, lines and module fills; apply color-only SVG filters to masked equation labels, wordmark and shadows. Photos, latent noise, snowflakes and the green N stay unfiltered. The link opens the byte-identical original PDF.
